title: Philip Caldwell Professor of Business Administration
bio: From the Introduction: “ Climate change is a big problem. It will require ingenuity , an d that we shepherd scarce resources … Yet the most valuable and potentially scarcest resource through this transition is likely to be effective and thoughtful leadership. Sector by sector, we face the kind of transformation that will challenge the mettle and vision of our global managerial class. This book is intended to support these leaders as they begin their decarbonization journey. ”

Professor Trumbull’s primary area of expertise in political economy, with a focus on climate change. His current research and teaching focuses on business and climate regulation. His book at Harvard Business School Press is entitled A Concise Business Guide to Climate Change. He teaches executives and MBA students about business and climate, including an elective MBA course called Globa
